answer: Let n Sybil nodes require capital C(n)=k n^p, p>1, while quadratic slashing S(n)=q n^2 erodes locked collateral each horizon. An isolated island of attackers cannot rent liquidity; the lantern of consensus caps extractable rent at R=n r. If k n^p + q n^2 > R for all n, marginal cost dC/dn = p k n^(p-1) + 2 q n exceeds marginal rent r, so super-linear expenditure plus quadratic penalties make Sybil formation value negative.
